description: This file defines the 'ZoneOnDemand' class, a dynamic shape used in OrchardCore's display management system to handle zones that are created on demand. It includes methods for dynamic member access, conversion, equality, and asynchronous addition of items to zones.

classes.name: ZoneOnDemand
classes.description: A dynamic shape class that represents a zone created on demand, supporting dynamic member access, conversion, equality, and async item addition.

methods.name: TryGetMember
methods.description: Handles dynamic member get requests, returning Nil.

methods.name: TryGetIndex
methods.description: Handles index get requests, returning Nil.

methods.name: TryInvokeMember
methods.description: Handles dynamic method invocation, returning Nil unless method is 'ToString'.

methods.name: TryConvert
methods.description: Handles type conversion requests, returning null or default instance based on target type.

methods.name: operator ==
methods.description: Equality operator, considers null and Nil instances as equal.

methods.name: Equals
methods.description: Checks object equality based on reference or null.

methods.name: GetHashCode
methods.description: Generates hash code based on parent and zone name.

methods.name: AddAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously adds an item to the zone, creating the zone if necessary.
